_provenance: NOT recorded from a live server — built from Overseerr's published OpenAPI spec (overseerr-api.yml, User schema + GET /user) on 2026-09-02. Re-record against a real instance when one is available.
_caveat: `displayName` is what the Overseerr UI shows and what the live API returns, but it is NOT in the published User schema — which documents `username`, `plexUsername` and `email`. The client falls through all four in that order, so a fork returning only the documented fields still names every account.
